articles.title: Michigan AG Files Antitrust Lawsuit Against Blue Cross Blue Shield
articles.summary: The Michigan Attorney General has filed an antitrust lawsuit against Blue Cross Blue Shield, challenging market practices that impact health plan competition and pricing. This legal action signals increasing state-level scrutiny on major health insurers and plan administrators, which could influence commercial contracting and cost management strategies for self-funded employers.

articles.title: Rising Benefits Costs Force Hard Choices for Small and Midsize Employers
articles.summary: Surging health benefits costs are putting immense financial pressure on small and midsize business (SMB) owners, forcing them to reconsider plan designs and cost-sharing strategies. For self-funded employers and PBMs, this highlights the growing urgency for aggressive cost containment, alternative benefit strategies, and transparent pharmacy pricing.

articles.title: PBM Specialty Copay Programs Pose Compliance and Financial Risks for Pharmacies
articles.summary: Specialty pharmacies face growing financial and operational vulnerabilities tied to PBM copay assistance and accumulator/maximizer programs. This dynamic impacts specialty drug management strategies and cost containment approaches for self-funded employer health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Pharmacy Practice News; Mon, 12 Oct 2026 05:30:05 GMT

articles.title: High Employer Turnover Among Pharmacy Benefit Advisors Threatens Plan Stability
articles.summary: A recent survey reveals that three in four employers are churning through their pharmacy benefits advisors, signaling widespread dissatisfaction with current plan performance and rising costs. This instability creates an opportunity for specialized PBMs to capture self-funded employers seeking more reliable guidance and transparent cost-management strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Mon, 12 Oct 2026 19:19:31 GMT

articles.title: RxBenefits Report Highlights High Turnover Among Pharmacy Benefits Advisors
articles.summary: A new RxBenefits report reveals that 75% of employers have changed or plan to change their pharmacy benefits advisors within a 12-month period. This high turnover signals growing employer dissatisfaction with traditional advisors and creates opportunities for independent, unbundled PBM models that serve self-funded plans.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Mon, 12 Oct 2026 13:00:00 GMT

articles.title: HHS Flags 340B Spread Pricing and Market Consolidation Risks
articles.summary: The Department of Health and Human Services has raised concerns regarding 340B drug pricing practices, specifically targeting spread pricing and industry consolidation. This federal scrutiny directly impacts the broader pharmacy supply chain and drug pricing dynamics that affect self-funded employer plan costs. The focus on spread pricing adds momentum to ongoing PBM and drug discount program regulatory reform efforts.

articles.title: Step Therapy Disruptions in Cancer Care Pose Strategic Challenges for Employers
articles.summary: Expert discussions highlight how step therapy protocols can cause critical delays and disruptions in oncology treatments, raising clinical and financial concerns for health plans. For self-funded employers, managing specialty drug utilization controls requires balancing strict cost-containment with patient outcomes and potential legislative pushback.
articles.source_line: Source: The American Journal of Managed Care; Mon, 12 Oct 2026 17:55:29 GMT
articles.source_name: The American Journal of Managed Care

articles.title: Rising Employer Healthcare Costs Demand Closer Plan Spending Oversight
articles.summary: Employers face mounting pressure from escalating healthcare costs, necessitating closer scrutiny of plan spending and pharmacy benefit management strategies. Self-funded employers must proactively evaluate their benefit designs and cost-containment measures to manage these impending financial increases effectively.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Mon, 12 Oct 2026 12:09:00 GMT
